company.shortDescription: Benepass is a benefits administration platform that helps companies manage and distribute employee perks and benefits.
company.description: Benepass is a benefits administration platform that helps companies manage and distribute employee perks and benefits. Through deep investments into the company's financial technology infrastructure, Benepass has made it easy for employers to offer global benefits that are personalized to every employee. The Benepass platform offers employees four different ways to spend their benefit dollars globally: card, mobile wallet, reimbursements, and a marketplace.

productsAndServices.description: A flexible spending account allowing employees to use pre-tax funds for various personal expenses like student loans, childcare, and eldercare.

productsAndServices.description: A benefits account supporting various family-related expenses such as childcare, eldercare, fertility, and adoption services.

productsAndServices.description: A modernized FSA platform for health and dependent care expenses with automated enrollment and easy employee access via physical and virtual cards.

productsAndServices.description: A card-based HRA solution allowing employees to pay for eligible healthcare expenses with employer-funded, tax-free dollars tailored to individual needs.
productsAndServices.name: Benepass Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)

productsAndServices.description: A benefits account that funds employee professional growth activities like courses, coaching, certifications, and conferences.
productsAndServices.name: Benepass Professional Development Account

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $40,000,000, or 53.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,538,045 to $274,390,946, a 77.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-15 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
